name: com.gameframex.unity.gameanalytics
description:
GameFrameX GameAnalytics — game data analytics facade and abstraction package. Provides the IGameAnalyticsManager contract, the BaseGameAnalyticsManager abstract module, a GameAnalyticsRegistry with provider registration, and the GameAnalyticsComponent facade exposing event reporting in simple, value-based, and custom-dictionary forms. Also covers event timers with Start / Pause / Resume / Stop, player id binding via SetPlayerId, and global SetPublicProperties / ClearPublicProperties; concrete analytics providers ship as separate channel packages. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX GameAnalytics — 游戏数据分析门面与抽象功能包。提供 IGameAnalyticsManager 契约、BaseGameAnalyticsManager 抽象模块、带提供者注册的 GameAnalyticsRegistry，以及 GameAnalyticsComponent 门面，支持简单事件、数值事件与自定义字典事件上报。同时提供 Start / Pause / Resume / Stop 事件计时器、经 SetPlayerId 绑定玩家标识，以及全局 SetPublicProperties / ClearPublicProperties；具体统计渠道以独立功能包提供。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
